about: What Seldon assumes about Omarchy (WP-194): installed files under $OMARCHY_PATH, each hashed read-only, each assumption naming the plugin (or engine) line that relies on it. `symbol` is found in the Omarchy file, `pluginSymbol` in the code (not a comment) of the cited plugin file; the line number is a hint, not a condition. scripts/check-omarchy-assumptions.sh (`just check-upstream`) compares the hashes; a file Omarchy stable does not ship has sha256 "absent" and its measurement in `edge`; on a mismatch, re-measure the assumption and update sha256, omarchyVersion, measured and the sentence in the same commit, never silence it. docs/TESTING.md, "Omarchy assumptions".

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the scoped facade's updateEntryInline(id, settings) replacing the plugin's own shell.json entry and returning true only when something changed, at plugin/Desk.qml:536.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk's settings writes (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh, settings scenarios) and one width change on the test host, read back from the shell.json entry

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the facade's serviceFor(own id) handing the bar widget the plugin's own Service.qml instance, at plugin/BarWidget.qml:56.
assumptions.remeasure: the pill finds its service (tests/plugin/bar-view.sh) and shows counts on the test host after a shell restart

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the facade's summon, hide and toggle taking the plugin's own id and returning true when they act, at plugin/BarWidget.qml:74.
assumptions.remeasure: a left click on the pill and `omarchy-shell jax.seldon.panel toggle` open and close the desk on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on a manifest with `overlay` and `bar-widget` being owned by the panel loader, so `shell summon|hide|toggle jax.seldon` reaches Desk.qml and hide() unloads it, at plugin/Desk.qml:177.
assumptions.remeasure: `omarchy-shell shell toggle jax.seldon` and `shell call jax.seldon view ""` on the test host (SPEC-PLUGIN §8)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the overlay loader assigning shell, manifest and service (the plugin's own Service.qml) after the desk is created, each starting as null, at plugin/Desk.qml:68.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk opens with its service bound (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh creates it bare and assigns in the shell's order) and `view` on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell's plugin reload clearing the component cache only when Qt offers it, so new plugin code needs a shell restart and the update notice offers one, at plugin/Service.qml:76.
assumptions.remeasure: after `omarchy plugin update` on the test host: the desk shows the restart notice and new code runs only after a restart (memory/omarchy-shell.md, WP-090)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell handing the service a fresh copy of manifest.json after every rescan, whose version the service compares with the code's own, at plugin/Service.qml:75.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/service-states.sh (update notice) and an `omarchy plugin update` on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell's updateEntryInline, behind the facade, replacing only the caller's own shell.json entry with { id } and the settings and returning true only when something changed, at plugin/Desk.qml:536.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk's settings writes (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh, settings scenarios) and one width change on the test host, read back from the shell.json entry

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell's serviceFor, behind the facade, returning the plugin's own service instance (and null before it mounts), at plugin/BarWidget.qml:56.
assumptions.remeasure: the pill finds its service (tests/plugin/bar-view.sh) and shows counts on the test host after a shell restart

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the third-party bar facade offering moduleWidgets(id) and a scoped shell, so one pill instance owns the `jax.seldon.panel` IPC target, at plugin/BarWidget.qml:139.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/bar-view.sh and tests/plugin/ipc-restart.sh, and no "another handler is registered" line in the test host's shell log

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the bar building the widget once per monitor plus a zero-size, hidden placeholder in the centre section, all listed by moduleWidgets, at plugin/Model.js:4501.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/bar-view.sh, and on the test host `omarchy-shell jax.seldon.panel pill` answers once with one handler

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell's pickDrawnSlot choosing the first visible, non-zero-size slot, which Model.pickDrawnWidget mirrors, at plugin/Model.js:4510.
assumptions.remeasure: the shell's pickDrawnSlot and isDrawnSlot against Model.pickDrawnWidget and isDrawnWidget (node tests/plugin/model.test.js), then tests/plugin/bar-view.sh

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the BarWidget base exposing the inline shell.json entry as settings and setting(name, fallback), at plugin/BarWidget.qml:47.
assumptions.remeasure: `omarchy bar set jax.seldon captureIntervalMin 30 --json` on the test host reaches the service (`omarchy-shell jax.seldon.service status`)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the Style tokens, among them Style.bar.iconCanvas (16 px at scale 1.0) sizing the pill's glyph box, at plugin/BarWidget.qml:250.
assumptions.remeasure: `just qmllint` (the token check against Commons) and the pill's glyph at scale 1.0 and 1.25 (tests/plugin/bar-view.sh)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on Commons/Style.qml being the only loaded importer of Quickshell.Hyprland in the Quickshell harnesses, so that Quickshell's one 'Cannot connect to hyprland' warning (its 'Unable to find hyprland socket' or '$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset' text) is Omarchy's (edge's Style.qml imports Quickshell.Hyprland and connects to its Hyprland singleton; stable's does not, and there the line is never accepted; the plugin's own importer is never loaded by a harness), at plugin/components/desk/DeskWindow.qml:4.
assumptions.remeasure: bash tests/plugin/upstream-warnings.test.sh, then the four harnesses (just plugin-test with SELDON_FULL_CHECK=1) on an edge tree: only that warning is accepted

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the Color tokens following the active theme, among them Commons.Color.popups.text as the desk's foreground, read through `import qs.Commons as Commons` because Qt 6.12's QtQuick has a Color singleton of its own that shadows the unqualified name (Omarchy edge, WP-224), at plugin/Desk.qml:137.
assumptions.remeasure: `just qmllint` (the token check) and the desk in two themes, one light (docs/TESTING.md, theme renders)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on Border.surfaceSpec(section, token, colour, width) giving the desk card the theme's popup border, at plugin/Desk.qml:715.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk card's border in tests/plugin/desk-view.sh renders and in two themes on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the qs.Ui BorderSurface drawing the desk card with its colour and borderSpec, at plugin/Desk.qml:706.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/desk-view.sh renders and the desk card on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on qs.Ui Button with focusable: true being a Tab stop that Enter and Space click, and on its label never eliding at the width the desk gives it (on edge a Button held narrower than its label shrinks the label to 75 % and then elides it), at plugin/components/desk/NewCaseSheet.qml:277.
assumptions.remeasure: the desk's key paths (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh, Tab and Enter scenarios) and the label-fit probe

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on qs.Ui ButtonGroup emitting changed(value) without assigning value itself, so a binding on value survives, at plugin/components/desk/NewCaseSheet.qml:180.
assumptions.remeasure: the new-case sheet's chips (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh) and a reset after submit

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on qs.Ui Dropdown exposing popupOpen and taking focus on an inner trigger, so the field counts as editing while its popup is open, at plugin/components/desk/JournalField.qml:36.
assumptions.remeasure: the journal field's keys (tests/plugin/desk-view.sh: Tab to the trigger, Down opens, Enter picks) with the desk's key catcher blocked meanwhile

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on `omarchy plugin update` pulling the git checkout and rescanning plugins without restarting the shell, which is why the update notice exists, at plugin/Service.qml:76.
assumptions.remeasure: `omarchy plugin update jax.seldon` on the test host with a newer checkout: the notice appears, nothing restarts by itself

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on omarchy-restart-shell, run without arguments from a detached process, restarting the shell and refusing while a secure lock is up (on edge it waits up to 30 s for the old shell and 60 s for the new one, then for the notification service, and exits 1 when the shell does not come back), at plugin/Model.js:4469.
assumptions.remeasure: the notice's Restart shell on the test host gives one new shell, within seconds on stable and within about a minute on edge (memory/omarchy-shell.md, WP-090)

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on Omarchy's validator accepting the manifest's schemaVersion 1, kinds, entry points and the unknown `seldon` key, and CI runs the same file through packaging/omarchy-pin, at plugin/manifest.json:2.
assumptions.remeasure: `omarchy plugin validate plugin/`, then refresh packaging/omarchy-pin to the new validator (packaging/README.md, "The Omarchy pin")

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the shell's plugin registry reading the manifest's keys and entry points per kind (the schema Omarchy's docs/omarchy-shell.md names in git since edge cut the installed shell README to an index of uninstalled docs), at plugin/manifest.json:10.
assumptions.remeasure: read PluginRegistry.qml's diff against SPEC-PLUGIN §1, §8 and memory/omarchy-shell.md, then `omarchy plugin validate plugin/`

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on `omarchy language <code>` writing exactly "# The session language, set by omarchy-language (Setup > Language)." and "export LANG=<locale>" to ~/.config/uwsm/env.d/50-omarchy-language, which the engine rebuilds as routine `omarchy-written` evidence (edge only; stable has no omarchy-language, ADR-0059), at engine/src/collectors/config.rs:1431.
assumptions.remeasure: compare omarchy-language's printf with LANGUAGE_ENV_TEXT, then `cargo test --test collector_hashes omarchy_written`; on a test host with edge, `omarchy language <code>` leaves `seldon drift` without an open item

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on `omarchy language <code>` writing the code and a newline to ~/.config/omarchy/language, a code being a key of default/i18n/locales.json (edge only, ADR-0059), at engine/src/collectors/config.rs:1450.
assumptions.remeasure: read omarchy-language's set_language, then `cargo test --test collector_hashes omarchy_written`

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on default/i18n/locales.json being one object keyed by language code, each value an object whose `locale` string is the LANG that omarchy-language writes (edge only, ADR-0059), at engine/src/collectors/config.rs:1522.
assumptions.remeasure: `jq 'to_entries[0]' $OMARCHY_PATH/default/i18n/locales.json` against the engine's `locales`, then `cargo test --test collector_hashes omarchy_written`

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on omarchy-default-agent listing every agent `omarchy default agent` accepts in one `# omarchy:args=[a|b|…]` line and writing the chosen one and a newline to ~/.config/omarchy/defaults/agent (on stable and edge; the lists differ, edge's has `agy` for `gemini`), at engine/src/collectors/config.rs:1466.
assumptions.remeasure: read the args line and the write in omarchy-default-agent, then `cargo test --test collector_hashes omarchy_written`

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on `omarchy dictation use <backend>` writing the backend and a newline to ~/.config/omarchy/defaults/dictation (edge only, ADR-0059), at engine/src/collectors/config.rs:1488.
assumptions.remeasure: read omarchy-dictation-use's write, then `cargo test --test collector_hashes omarchy_written`

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on each dictation backend having an installer named omarchy-install-dictation-<backend> that selects that backend, here voxtype (edge only, ADR-0059), at engine/src/collectors/config.rs:1483.
assumptions.remeasure: `ls $OMARCHY_PATH/bin/omarchy-install-dictation-*` and each one's `omarchy-dictation-use` line, then `cargo test --test collector_hashes omarchy_written`

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on each dictation backend having an installer named omarchy-install-dictation-<backend> that selects that backend, here superwhisper (edge only, ADR-0059), at engine/src/collectors/config.rs:1483.
assumptions.remeasure: `ls $OMARCHY_PATH/bin/omarchy-install-dictation-*` and each one's `omarchy-dictation-use` line, then `cargo test --test collector_hashes omarchy_written`

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on omarchy-show-done <code> printing Omarchy's "Failed (exit code <code>)!" for a non-zero code and "Done!" for 0 on edge, and "Done!" for every status on stable, whose omarchy-show-done takes no code, so a failed terminal step ends with status 1 after its red line, at plugin/Model.js:143.
assumptions.remeasure: tests/plugin/terminal-scripts.sh (its edge and stable wrappers) against the new omarchy-show-done, then one failed terminal step on the test host

assumptions.relies: Seldon relies on the presentation launcher running a terminal script and then omarchy-show-done unless the script ended with 130 (Ctrl+C), passing the script's status as the code on edge and no code on stable, at plugin/Model.js:239.
assumptions.remeasure: read the launcher's presentation_script against tests/plugin/terminal-scripts.sh's edge_wrapper and stable_wrapper, then one failed and one cancelled terminal step on the test host
